summary: Speech-like gibberish voices for any line of text in any script: synthesized syllables (formant vowels after plosive, nasal, fricative or liquid onsets) chosen by the text itself, with intonation from punctuation (questions rise, exclamations start high), moods, tone-language pitch, and a mouth-flap event per syllable.
setup: List Babble in Game(systems=[...]) (from game.lib.babble import Babble).

Call speak(ctx, npc, "Bonjour, ça va ?", voice="hi", mood="excited") from game.lib.babble; it returns the line's seconds. Options: voice "lo"/"hi", pitch, rate, volume, mood (calm, excited, frustrated, sad, pleading, shout), tonal=True for tone languages.
Flap a mouth on Babbled(speaker, openness, loud); BabbleFinished(speaker) follows the last syllable. stop(ctx, npc) cuts a line off.
